guide.summary: Palace museums, galleries, a river mall and night market, rooftop and cocktail bars, Thai tasting menus, pad thai and Charoen Krung breakfast cafés, each checked against its own website.
guide.tip: Thipsamai's Pratoopee shop closes every Tuesday and MOCA Bangkok closes on Mondays, so keep those days for the Grand Palace, which opens daily with tickets sold 8:30 AM to 3:30 PM.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: MOCA Bangkok is open Tuesday to Sunday and closed Mondays, as is Sarnies & Friends in Talat Noi. Thipsamai's Pratoopee branch closes every Tuesday.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: Grand Palace tickets cost 500 baht and are sold only from 8:30 AM to 3:30 PM. At Jim Thompson House, adults pay 250 baht and you can enter only with a guide.

toolkit.label: Walk-in or book
toolkit.copy: Sky Bar at lebua takes walk-ins only, with no reservations. Mezzaluna, one floor up, needs a deposit through TableCheck, and changes are free up to 72 hours ahead.

toolkit.label: Dress and age
toolkit.copy: Sky Bar is smart casual and refuses athletic wear, swimwear, sleeveless shirts for men and flip-flops. Mezzaluna requires collared shirts and long trousers for men, and both admit children aged 7 and above with an adult.

guide.dek: Start at the Grand Palace early because ticket sales stop at 3:30 PM, and book Bangkok's tasting-menu dinners ahead while keeping rooftop drinks at Sky Bar flexible as a walk-in.
intro: You can start in Rattanakosin at the Grand Palace, which opens daily from 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM. Tickets cost 500 baht and are sold only until 3:30 PM. Inside the palace grounds, the Queen Sirikit Museum of Textiles opens daily from 09.00 to 16.30, with last admission at 15.30. Its exhibition "Royal Court Textiles of Siam" runs until April 30, 2027. The Bangkok National Museum on Na Phra That Road posts a monthly opening calendar on its own site, so check it before you go.

In Pathum Wan, Jim Thompson House is open every day from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and you can enter the house only with a guide. Adults pay 250 baht. Next door, the Jim Thompson Art Center is showing "And Still, Another After" from 10 October 2026 to 29 March 2027. For contemporary art further north, MOCA Bangkok opens Tuesday to Sunday from 10.00 am to 06.00 pm. Adult tickets cost 400 baht, and children under 13 enter free.

For views, Mahanakhon SkyWalk opens from 10 AM to midnight, last access 11 PM, and tickets range from 500 to 1,200 baht depending on the time. Sky Bar on the 64th floor of State Tower takes walk-ins only and admits children aged 7 and above with an adult. On the river, Asiatique The Riverfront opens every day from 11:00 to midnight. With children, you can visit SEA LIFE Bangkok in the basement of Siam Paragon, open 10.00 to 20.00. One Bangkok's "Fortune Teller" exhibition runs to 15 November.

For food, Thipsamai's original Pratoopee shop on Mahachai Road serves pad thai from 9:00AM to midnight and closes every Tuesday. nahm at COMO Metropolitan serves dinner daily from 6.00pm, and Bo.lan on Sukhumvit 53 takes bookings through TableCheck. Sorn offers its Seasonal Menu on selected dates, including 26–28 October and 16–19 November 2026. For breakfast along Charoen Krung, Sarnies Bangkok opens daily at 08:00 and Sarnies Sourdough at 07:30. Sarnies Sourdough bakes its sourdough in-house and roasts its own coffee.
summaryCards: Arrive at the Grand Palace before ticket sales end at 3:30 PM, then visit the Queen Sirikit Museum of Textiles inside the palace grounds, which takes last admission at 15.30.
Have breakfast from 08:00 at Sarnies & Friends in The Corner House in Talat Noi, open Tuesday to Sunday, then take the guided tour of Jim Thompson House from 10:00 AM.
Mezzaluna takes a deposit through TableCheck with free changes up to 72 hours ahead, while Sky Bar downstairs takes walk-ins only.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several input places could not be checked: Wat Arun, Jay Fai, Here Hai, Som Tam Nua, Teens of Thailand and Conkey's had no official website identified. Gaggan Anand, Kay's Boutique Breakfast, Landhaus Bakery and Eric Kayser's guessed domains did not resolve. Rocket Coffeebar, Factory Coffee and Nana Coffee Roasters failed or rate-limited, and the Bamboo Bar page showed only navigation. Tropic City's own site says it has closed. BACC, the Siam Society, The Peninsula, Banyan Tree, Four Seasons and Capella returned 403. Some places are published only partially: Bangkok National Museum, ICONSIAM, One Bangkok, Sorn, Le Du, Mezzaluna and Sky Bar had no readable weekly hours. nahm and SEA LIFE gave a building, not a street address. The Grand Palace, Le Du, Vesper and Asiatique pages carried no 2026-dated content.
